releases.notes:
# Lumen Terrain 2.0.0 Preview 2

Lumen Terrain 2.0.0 Preview 2 is the second preview of the LTE 2.0 architecture.

## What's new

- New hardware detection and profiling system
- Automatic CPU/GPU benchmarking
- Automatic backend selection
- OpenCL compute backend
- Intel integrated GPU support through OpenCL
- CPU fallback when GPU acceleration isn't selected or available
- New terrain generation pipeline
- Chunk processing cache
- Improved chunk processing architecture
- Native OpenCL terrain processing through JNI
- Removed the previous Vulkan backend implementation

## Native library

Linux users must also install:

`libLumenTerrainEngine.so`

The native library is currently distributed separately from the JAR.

> Native library packaging will be improved for the final 2.0.0 release.

## Status

**Preview / experimental**

This release is intended for testing and development. Performance, compatibility, and terrain-generation behaviour may still change before the final 2.0.0 release.

# Lumen Terrain 2.0 Preview 1

The first public preview of LTE 2.0.

## Added

- New terrain processing pipeline
- Dedicated LTE worker system
- Native C++ backend
- JNI communication layer
- Vulkan hardware detection
- Vulkan compute benchmarking
- Hardware capability detection

## Status

This is an early preview release.

The Vulkan backend is functional and tested, with live GPU terrain compute integration still being developed.

CPU terrain processing remains the active generation path.

## Requirements

- Minecraft Fabric
- Java 21+
- Vulkan-capable hardware recommended

## Native Vulkan Backend

This preview includes an experimental native Vulkan compute backend.

Linux users who want to test GPU compute should download:

- lumen-terrain-engine-2.0.0-preview.jar
- libLumenTerrainEngine.so

Place both files according to the installation instructions.

Native library packaging will be improved in a future release.
